title: Relay tunnel: keep 4 pollers?
summary: Data analysis into a decision: a benchmark of the relay's tunnel and production timings, charted, then three decisions with my recommendations.
description: I benchmarked how pages travel through the relay, charted it, and turned it into three decisions. The charts carry the argument: hover a bar for its value, and the table under them has every number. My recommendations are pre-selected.

fields.label: What I measured
fields.text:
Every form page reaches a visitor through the relay: the relay holds the request, one of the machine's **pollers** (open long-polls) picks it up, the machine renders the page and posts it back. Today every machine keeps **4 pollers** open. Is that the right number, and is the long-poll worth replacing?

**Bench** (in-process, loopback, 400 page loads per cell, `ASK_FORM_BENCH=1 go test -run TestTunnelLatency ./internal/relay`): the same form page served directly and through the relay, with 1–8 pollers and 1–32 visitors at once.

fields.label: The numbers (p95 · pages/s)
fields.text:
| | 1 visitor | 8 at once | 32 at once |
|---|---|---|---|
| no relay | 5 ms · 406/s | 18 ms · 951/s | 71 ms · 982/s |
| 1 poller | 7 ms · 296/s | 40 ms · 295/s | 151 ms · 269/s |
| 2 pollers | 7 ms · 280/s | 31 ms · 386/s | 87 ms · 407/s |
| **4 pollers (today)** | 7 ms · 298/s | 31 ms · 454/s | 94 ms · 455/s |
| 8 pollers | 7 ms · 295/s | 24 ms · 618/s | 105 ms · 481/s |

**Reading it.** With one visitor the relay costs about **half a millisecond** at the median, whatever the poller count. Pollers only matter under load: one poller caps out around **290 pages/s** and serialises everyone (p95 150 ms at 32 visitors). 4 pollers roughly match 8 on wait time and give the best p95 at 32 visitors. 8 only wins throughput at 8 visitors. Direct is about **2×** the relay's best: that's the price of the extra hop.

fields.label: Reading it
fields.text:
60 loads each, from the lab through the real public path (Freebox → raspy2 passthrough → Traefik → relay), on 2026-10-27.

- Relay alone: **54 ms** median, 3.1 ms of it server-side.
- A form page through the tunnel: **70 ms** median (p95 93 ms), 8.7 ms server-side.

The tunnel and the rendering add about **6 ms**. The visitor mostly waits on the connection and TLS through the passthrough, which no tunnel change would touch.

options.description: Fewer idle connections. Fine for one person answering; p95 87 ms at 32 visitors.

options.label: 4: keep today's default (recommended)
options.description: Best p95 at 32 visitors (94 ms vs 105 for 8), 455 pages/s.
Best throughput at 8 visitors (618/s), but a worse tail at 32.
